title: The Horror of Breaking the Rules

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic plane whose night-lurking monsters survive heroes' best efforts to kill them and return stronger.

events.summary: The column describes Innistrad's night creatures coming back stronger after being killed, making monsters more fearsome to the humans of the world.
events.quote: The night-lurking creatures of Innistrad not only survive the heroes' best efforts to kill them, but come back stronger than ever.
